hits.title: Vault 2.0 economy plugins
hits.description:
What is Vault2.0?
Vault2.0 is an economy plugin that registers a Bukkit Economy service compatible with the Vault API, allowing other plugins (shops, ranks, etc.) to use money without depending on the original Vault.jar. It includes menus, pay/charge flows

hits.title: EconomyGUI
hits.description: Economy GUI a powerful and intuitive Minecraft plugin for efficient economy management using a beautiful GUI!

hits.title: EconomyBridge
hits.description: A lightweight library plugin to handle multiple various currency and custom item plugins.

hits.title: Divinity Economy (Global Market)
hits.description: A global dynamic market with the ability to buy and sell every item, enchants and experience in the game, and scales with supply and demand. A truly revolutionary and unique plugin packed with tons of features.

hits.title: EconomyShopBuyAddon
hits.description: An addon plugin that adds a "/buy" command to purchase items directly from your existing shop plugin e.g. EconomyShopGui.
